promptDescription: This is a cropped tie-front knit top with a deep V-shaped front opening and a central bow-knot closure. It has long sleeves, ribbed cuffs and hem, and scalloped edges along the neckline and opening. The garment uses an open crochet-like knit with alternating solid and openwork stripe bands across the body and sleeves.

Pants with a wide, flat waistband and a high-rise fit. The front features two vertical pleats extending from the waistband to the hem. There are no visible closures or pockets on the front. The pants have a straight-leg silhouette with a clean, flat hem at the bottom. Vertical seams run down the front of each leg, contributing to the structured appearance.
